alex_k: Heads-up: we need runtime + infra + console to agree on the exact metric spec for per-model/route SLO dashboards. I sketched a checklist below.

maria_p: Yes please — we should lock names and labels before grafana panels go live. p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec are the must-haves.

alex_k: checklist (short):
- canonical metric names
- required labels (model, route, variant?)
- aggregation windows (5m for TTFT, 5m/1m? for percentiles)
- sampling/ingest cost controls
- dashboard panel queries + thresholds
- rollout plan for console panels + consumer docs

tariq_s: quick comment on labels: keep cardinality low. model + route required. variant can be optional (only when stable). avoid including quantization bits or hardware type as labels — surface those in a different telemetry view.

jen_product: agree on route being the glue for console UX. we need stable route ids, not ad-hoc names developers change. Can eng-platform guarantee a `route_id` label?

alex_k: yes — runtime will emit `route_id` and `model_id`. we'll de-dupe on ingest side and map aliases to canonical route_id.

sam_sre: ops-bot flagged that adding `variant` label increases cardinality by ~10x for some models. If variant is optional, we should default to no-variant in dashboards and add a toggle to break out if needed.

ops-bot: ingest_quota: adding a new metric with labels > 3 extra cardinality will touch the billing tier. Please file a telemetry PR describing expected series growth.

alex_k: below are suggested PromQL queries for panels (feel free to tweak):
```promql
# P50/P95/P99 using histogram buckets, 5m window
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(model_route_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route_id))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(model_route_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route_id))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(model_route_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route_id))

# TTFT: avg time to first token per route (5m rolling)
avg(rate(model_route_time_to_first_token_seconds_sum[5m])) by (model_id, route_id) / avg(rate(model_route_time_to_first_token_seconds_count[5m])) by (model_id, route_id)

# tokens/sec: tokens emitted per second per route (1m window)
rate(model_route_tokens_total[1m]) by (model_id, route_id) / rate(model_route_request_count[1m]) by (model_id, route_id)
```

maria_p: those look good. two notes: 1) use `sum(rate(...))` for numerator when doing cross-instance aggregation, 2) TTFT metric name should be `model_route_ttft_seconds` to be explicit.

alex_k: updated names: `model_route_request_duration_seconds_bucket`, `model_route_ttft_seconds_sum/count`, `model_route_tokens_total`, `model_route_request_count`. We'll add `p95_threshold` as a separate annotation from product.

jen_product: UX question — how do we show SLO burn? We want P95 > baseline to trigger alerting and show burn rates per-route in console.

sam_sre: SLO burn needs request-level SLI. Two approaches: 1) compute in Prometheus/Thanos using recorded rules (cheaper on query), 2) compute at ingest (more expensive but simpler for trace back). Prefer 1) with recorded rules that produce `model_route_sli_error_rate` and `model_route_sli_total`.

alex_k: agreed. we'll add recorded rules that emit `model_route_sli_error_ratio` per 5m and `model_route_sli_window_count`. Console will consume those for burn charts.

ops-bot: NOTE: recorded rules must be added to infra repo and scheduled to avoid high CPU on prometheus. Limit cardinality to model_id, route_id.

alex_k: rollout plan:
- this week: finalize metric names + labels (owner: alex_k)
- next week: runtime emits metrics in canary 10% traffic (owner: tariq_s)
- infra: add scrape/recording rules + PR for ingestion mapping (owner: sam_sre)
- console: build panels with queries and a toggle to show variant breakdown (owner: maria_p)
- docs: telemetry.md updates + sample queries (owner: jen_product)

maria_p: also need thresholds for color bands. product will provide p50/p95 targets per model group. I'll attach later.

alex_k: action items logged in the ticket. small follow-ups: 1) confirm aggregation windows (5m for percentiles and TTFT), 2) final label set (model_id, route_id, maybe variant), 3) recorded rules PR by EOD Wed.

tariq_s: I'll start the canary patch and include a feature flag for `emit_route_labels`.

sam_sre: I'll draft the recorded rules and include notes on expected series cardinality.

alex_k: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene once infra PR is up. :thumbsup:
